pr_title: cmd/evm: add 256-bit field validations on transactions (t9n)
pr_body:
Fixes #23740

Additionally, it checks the extra fields in type-2 (1559) transactions.
pr_comments:
Updated to also validate that `gas * gasPrice` is within 256 bits, and output intrinsic gas (if we got that far) 
Fixes #23746

issue_context.title: evm t9n export transaction intrinsic gas if transaction is valid
issue_context.body:
Would be nice to know the intrinsic gas price of a transaction unit 
for this rules 
https://github.com/ethereum/tests/pull/957/files#diff-c838aa6c0864dca1e3dec55c510e409317c9b7806251d9124a529d6ec693d22aR11

so then we can make even more test for transaction gas calculation

review_comments:
I think we also need a clause `(GasFeeCap + GasTipCap) * Gas`
But I am not sure why you would want to restrict the bitlen in the t8n tool, wouldn't it be better to create such transactions to test the implementations?

> But I am not sure why you would want to restrict the bitlen in the t8n tool, wouldn't it be better to create such transactions to test the implementations?

Right, but we don't actually restrict the bitlen -- `t9n` still returns all the fields (sender, hash etc), but it _also_ returns an error. So the tooling which does the tests can use the error info to check that "yes, the test I wrote does indeed trigger the error I was trying to trigger", but still use the data that it spits out. 

> (GasFeeCap + GasTipCap) * Gas

Why add them? Should be sufficient to check them individually.
Ahh nvm I meant `GasFeeCap*Gas`, and since I only inspected a subset of the changes I missed that you already had a clause for that
